provenance.title: Jobs

why_this_recording_exists: Ashby serves HTTP 200 with the bare title 'Jobs' for a board token that does not exist — verified 2026-08-02 against this token, whose API endpoint 404s. This is the real recorded shape of a page that does not name an employer, and it is why extract_ashby_name must reduce a title of only the suffix to None rather than to ''.
